Package com.avpkit.core

Class SimpleMediaFile

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.avpkit.core.SimpleMediaFile
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ISimpleMediaFile
    public class SimpleMediaFile
extends java.lang.Object
implements ISimpleMediaFile
    An implementation of ISimpleMediaFile. Provides a generic bag of attributes about a SimpleMediaFile.
